concept.hr: AD DS, DNS zona i SRV zapisi, SYSVOL i prva replikacija
concept.en: AD DS, the DNS zone and SRV records, SYSVOL, the first replication

summary.hr: DC01 korak po korak postaje prvi kontroler domene, pa DC02 drugi. Krivi DNS na DC02 ili DC01 bez DNS-a i domenu nitko ne nalazi.
summary.en: Step DC01 becoming the first domain controller, then DC02 the second. With the wrong DNS on DC02, or DC01 without DNS, nobody finds the domain.

concept.hr: Nova šuma: baza, DNS zone, SYSVOL, FSMO i SRV zapisi
concept.en: A new forest: database, DNS zones, SYSVOL, FSMO and SRV records

concept.hr: Nalazi domenu u DNS-u, replicira particije i SYSVOL
concept.en: Finds the domain in DNS, replicates the partitions and SYSVOL
